asr.full_text: You're welcome. How can you make money with one? There are nine different ways to profit from our bonus program. The Direct sales bonus The Network bonus The Matching bonus The Start up bonus One life points Double your money with splits the gold bonus and our leadership program You also receive a free eWallet for safe and secure payments Direct Sales and Network Bonus You get 10 percent bonus on all personal sales associated to the business volume that's BV a direct sales bonus on all personal sales associated to the business volume that's BV. This means for every sale you make you get a direct sales bonus. The network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team. You receive 10 percent of all business volume from your sales team. The member that joins your team and with you as a sponsor will be placed on your right and your left side. You decide left or right. You can also let the system do this for you with our alternative setting. Matching Bonus. The matching bonus helps you grow your team and make you successful. Points can be redeemed for items such as holidays luxury items and exclusive rewards splits as the one tokens increase in price on our exchange you will profit not only from the price increase but moreover through the split of the token this means you double your amount at tokens after a split by holding a taken status you can split up to two times that means four double your amount of Tokens after a split. By holding a tycoon's status, you can split up to two times. That means four times your money. Gold Bonus One has partnered up with the new type of crypto currency. A so called '' hybrid currency'' The first on the market to backup the currency with solid gold. As a bonus, you collect Aurum Gold Coins. Each coin is backed up with one milligram of solid gold. These coins you receive for free as a member of one. Leadership program. OUN rewards you for being a top performer and joining our leadership program. The program gives you special promotions such as cars, luxury watches and other life-changing experiences. So as you can see ONE provides you with attractive bonus program for you to build a successful career. Join today and start building your team!

textual.observation: The source promotes percentage bonuses tied to personal sales and a sponsored sales-team structure.

evidence.quote: You receive 10 percent of all business volume from your sales team.
The member that joins your team and with you as a sponsor will be placed on your right and your left side.

textual.context: Direct promotional presentation addressed to prospective participants.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised percentage bonus is explicitly linked to personal sales and sponsored team participation, creating a reward-and-recruitment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether sales, enrollments, or bonus payments occurred or whether the program is legitimate.

textual.observation: The source describes a startup bonus and additional sales bonus conditioned on a first product-package purchase, alongside urgency to build a team.

evidence.quote: up to 25 percent startup bonus during your first 30 days from your first purchase on a product package
you can receive an additional 10 percent on direct sales so keep your momentum and build your team because the clock is ticking.

textual.context: The statements are presented as promotional instructions rather than as a warning or report.
textual.potential_relevance: The source links time-limited bonuses to a first purchase and team-building activity, with explicit urgency attached to the requested actions.
textual.limitations: The records do not specify the product-package price, full eligibility terms, fees, or whether the bonuses were actually paid.

visual.observation: A presentation slide states that members who personally generate sales receive a 10% bonus based on associated Business Volume, and that members who join with a sponsor are placed on the sponsor's left or right side; it also describes 60% going to a cash account and 40% funding a mandatory account.
visual.context: Promotional compensation-plan presentation for the OneCoin concept.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised monetary return is linked to generating sales and sponsoring or placing new members in a network structure.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the compensation was paid, whether participants purchased anything, or whether the described accounts or currency functioned as stated.

visual.observation: A slide states that during the first 30 days after joining, members receive an additional 10% of direct sales generated during that period and urges them to keep sponsoring people because time is limited.
visual.context: Promotional slide describing a time-limited start-up bonus.
visual.potential_relevance: An additional monetary return is tied to joining, generating direct sales, and sponsoring people within a stated 30-day period, with urgency language about the clock ticking.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the joining process, any payment, eligibility details beyond the stated period, or the outcome of the promotion.

visual.observation: A slide says that as more members join, demand for tokens and the price of OneTokens on the exchange grow, and describes an opportunity to split and double money; it says new members can join at low prices and advises accumulating or buying more tokens.
visual.context: Promotional presentation about token price growth and token splits.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed increase in token value and a promised doubling through splits are connected to joining, accumulating, or buying tokens.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not verify any market price, exchange activity, token ownership, purchases, or realized returns.

visual.observation: A leadership-program slide says top performers can join a leadership group and receive rewards for hard work and outstanding performance, with promotions every 3 to 6 months offering rewards ranging from gold and watches to a car.
visual.context: Promotional slide describing a performance-based leadership rewards program.
visual.potential_relevance: Valuable physical rewards are offered in connection with qualifying as a top performer, joining the leadership group, and meeting the program's performance conditions.
visual.limitations: The frames do not specify the performance thresholds, selection process, availability, or whether any rewards were actually provided.

textual_context_notes.observation: The supplied text uses direct promotional language inviting viewers to join and build a business or team.

evidence.quote: You 're welcome to Join free here to starting your Business ...
Join today and start building your team!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a multi-level team in which earnings depend on sponsoring members, team volume, and purchases of higher-status packages. It encourages participation with recruitment-dependent points and bonuses, claims that token splits can double or quadruple holdings, and uses urgency to invite viewers to join. These combined recruitment and appreciation promises present the program as an opportunity for easy wealth rather than as neutral commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video explicitly describes sponsors, left-and-right team placement, business volume from a sales team, and matching bonuses across up to four generations. S05 is separately supported because token price appreciation and repeated splits are promoted as ways to increase holdings and profit.
